title: DOJ Targets 800 Defendants in Largest-Ever Scam Crackdown, Including Crypto Fraud
summary: Bitcoin Magazine DOJ Targets 800 Defendants in Largest-Ever Scam Crackdown, Including Crypto Fraud The Justice Department said its largest-ever scam crackdown has targeted more than 800 defendants since March, with Southeast Asian crypto scam centers among its top targets. This post DOJ Targets 800 Defendants in Largest-Ever Scam Crackdown, Including Crypto Fraud first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
